mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a noble and very important profession which Islam encourages because all the living creatures of Allah need food to survive."
Farming is a noble and very important profession which Islam encourages because all the living creatures of Allah need food to survive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the drivers who safely drive their children to the world."
Mothers are the drivers who safely drive their children to the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best quality for choosing a good wife. 5."
Religious quality is the best quality for choosing a good wife. 5.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a compassionate God who has been so kind and merciful to His creatures."
Allah is a compassionate God who has been so kind and merciful to His creatures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those married women who have lost their husbands to death."
Widows are those married women who have lost their husbands to death.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a kind of behaviour in which somebody pretends to have moral standards or opinions that they do not actually have."
Hypocrisy is a kind of behaviour in which somebody pretends to have moral standards or opinions that they do not actually have.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the 'drivers' through whom children are conveyed into the world."
Parents are the 'drivers' through whom children are conveyed into the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a religion that cherishes dignity of self-empowerment."
Islam is a religion that cherishes dignity of self-empowerment.
